description: This is a plush armchair upholstered in a rich emerald green material, likely leather or a high-quality faux leather. Both the curved backrest and the square seat cushion are adorned with a classic tufted design, featuring evenly spaced buttons that create a quilted pattern. The armrests have a smooth, upholstered curve, complemented by dark, sleek, possibly wooden or laminate panels on the outer sides, offering a striking contrast to the green. The chair is supported by short, dark legs, suggesting a sturdy and inviting piece of furniture designed for comfort and elegance.
